title: Prevent malformed launcher run directories when Git echoes an unsupported rev-parse option
outcome: The launcher accepts only a valid run-directory result from Git and either resolves it correctly on the Mac agent's Git or refuses with a clear compatibility error before creating artifacts or registering.
acceptance: On Git output containing an echoed unsupported --path-format=absolute option, the launcher never creates a malformed relative directory or submits it for registration; it resolves the intended Git metadata directory through a supported path query or refuses with a named compatibility diagnostic before side effects.

Focused regressions cover the Git 2.29.2 output shape, normal current-Git paths, linked-worktree metadata paths, and paths with spaces; supported shapes retain canonical registration and execution behavior, with the required review and exact-input gate evidence.
disposal_reason: Duplicate filed during concurrent triage; Fable2 #613 identifies canonical w-604b535e1e3b, already owned by Sol-c593. Same Git2.29 unsupported-option path and registration refusal.
